scope: 51 actual authenticated original ChatGPT Wayland commits from one private Ubuntu session, serials 197 through 247 in source order. Native Win64 Python and Windows Node/CanvasKit under Wine. Measures guard.local_texture only, excluding networking, composition and WM_PAINT.
bindingCache: within this single process + application-surface lifetime and drawing SHA-256; unknown or unpaired inputs remain rejected

inputs.method: The source journal matched each offset and original surface commit. For the replay we restored its binding in a fresh guard and measured original CLRP verification, local CanvasKit replay or reuse, and production texture validation. SHA comparison is on the complete RGBA texture after each accepted commit.

limits.retention: one confirmed surface lifetime; drop on UNREF or protocol failure
